detailed_description:
The target video continues <Video 1> from its final frame, keeping the same live-action, cinematic style with light rain, dusk tones, and restrained camera movement, in one unbroken single shot.
[Shot 1] The shot opens on the exact final frame of <Video 1>: a medium close-up of <Subject 1>, the young man in the dark wool coat, seen from the waist up at the roadside, his right arm raised beside his head with the palm open to the rain, raindrops beading on his skin, his gaze lowered to the water gathering in his hand. Without any cut or change in framing, he slowly closes his fingers into a loose fist, trapping a little water inside, then turns his hand over and lets the droplets fall from his fist to the wet pavement. He lowers his right arm back to his side, his gaze dropping from his hand to the street ahead, takes a breath, and turns away from the camera. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as he walks away along the wet street into the deepening rain, his dark coat growing smaller in the frame, pale streetlights glowing through the drizzle, until the final frame holds his retreating figure.

overall_soundscape:
The rain ambience of <Video 1>, referenced as <Audio 1>, continues throughout the target video: steady light rain pattering on the wet pavement, the soft rustle of his wool coat as he moves, and footsteps growing fainter as he walks away.

non_diegetic_music:
The sparse piano score of <Video 1> (referenced via <Audio 1>) continues: a few slow, widely spaced piano notes with long silences, with the low sustained string pad held at a barely audible level and fading out completely by the final frame.
